name: Flawless Greenhouse: manual frame and roof

pages.text: Build this greenhouse manually. Choose an interior length L within the server limit (shipped maximum 64). Its total width is four blocks. The controller is side 0, inside 0, height 0. The two central columns hold crops; the outer columns provide walls and irrigation.$p$(l)Frame rules$()$pNear and far ends — Inside 0 and L+1; side 0–3 at height −1 are Stable Stone.$pEnd pillars — Side 0 and 3 at heights 0 and 1 are Stable Stone. The near controller replaces one corner.$pRoof — Every row from inside 0 through L+1: side 0–3 at height 2 are Bottom Quartz Slabs.$pSide walls — Inside 1–L: sides 0 and 3 at heights 0 and 1 are Flawless Glass.$pGrowing cells — Inside 1–L: sides 1 and 2 at height 0 above dirt/farmland.$pIrrigation — Inside 1–L: sides 0 and 3 at height −1 start as convertible dirt/grass/farmland.$pExample L=3: roof, height 2: see the native or master Foundations reader for the interactive or layered view.$pExample L=3: height 1: see the native or master Foundations reader for the interactive or layered view.$pExample L=3: height 0: see the native or master Foundations reader for the interactive or layered view.$pExample L=3: height −1: see the native or master Foundations reader for the interactive or layered view.$pPlace a CO₂ Generator at side 3, inside 0, height 0, facing the same way as the controller. All fourteen greenhouse inputs can hold seeds. This tier has no automatic Build or Demolish controls.

Actual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:machines/co2_generator)CO₂ Generator and Controlled Fuel$()$p$(l:foundations_calculator:farming/growing)Farming cycle and crop tiers$()
